decisions.statement: The pins table is ruled on.
The book ids table is ruled on.
The icons table is ruled on.
A table is carried out of Lua before that table is walked.
The upstream data file is loaded as a chunk.
The chunk is handed a line binding the local pins table to a reachable name.
The item ids the pins imply are counted against the upstream item table.
The textures the pins imply are counted against the upstream texture table.
A count is reported as a count rather than as a leaf comparison.
The Lua machine is closed once the ruling settles.
Nothing here writes a ported file.

definition: the ruling on whether the ported LibTreasure data still matches upstream
